name: Roy G. Guerrero Disc Golf Course

photos.alt: Roy G. Guerrero Disc Golf Course disc golf course

aboutParagraphs: Roy G. Guerrero is Austin's big-arm proving ground — an open, sprawling course along the Colorado River that Mike Olse redesigned into a modern distance test. From the long tees it stretches nearly 9,600 feet at par 61, with holes that reward power and punish hesitation.

It's free to play with Mach X baskets and concrete tees, and the flat, open fairways mean you can see your mistakes from 300 feet away. The wind off the river is the course's other designer — it turns routine par 3s into guesswork.
Bring your longest drivers and a full water bottle. This is where Austin's arms come to measure themselves.

signatureHoleDescription: Hole 18 is the longest on the card at 831 feet — an open, big-arm finish that sums up Roy G. Mike Olse's redesign is all about distance and wind, and this closer asks for both: a massive drive, a confident approach, and one last putt with the river breeze in your face.
localTips: Roy G is a big-arm course — the long layout stretches nearly 9,600 feet, so pace yourself and pack water. Expect wind off the river on exposed holes, and give yourself time: this is not a quick round. Free to play, Mach X baskets, concrete tees.
